causes.cause: Actual ReuiSidebar navigation keeps Projects as a button with the count in a sibling badge. The old locator incorrectly required Projects plus the count inside its accessible name.
causes.fix: Use exact button name Projects; existing project creation, rename and old-name removal assertions are unchanged.

causes.test: echo promotes its actual secondary implementations and copies the exact ZIP source
causes.cause: The published Echo source priority now promotes the native Sidebar and Settings modules after the template leaf, while the old fixture still expected Composer and Projects first.
causes.fix: Synchronize only the Echo module fixture with the published priority; existing source text, native clipboard and ZIP byte equality assertions are unchanged.
